evidence.observation: Purge brought O2 down from 28764 to 15 ppm, and it stayed around 3-6 ppm afterward
Ramp followed the setpoint within about 1 °C; a brief 10.7 °C overshoot at the start of growth settled to about 750 °C
Heater power holds steady at about 47% during growth, with no unexplained change
Pressure stays steady at about 3.03 Torr with Ar at 100 sccm, so no sign of a leak or blockage
Controller status reads running and the readings keep changing, so the status is not stale

args.missing_evidence: Characterization of the sample after the run (e.g., Raman or optical) is needed to judge whether the material grew.
